issues.issue: Whether the redetermining PRRA officer was bound by the Federal Court's earlier findings of fact and documentary-evidence comments (Yansane 2 and 3)
issues.applicant_position: Minister: earlier findings of fact and comments were not binding on the officer; only explicit judgment directions bind.
issues.respondent_position: Not stated; the Federal Court held the earlier findings of fact and directions had to be followed.
issues.result_quote: It was clearly an obiter dictum and not binding.

issues.issue: Whether directions in the earlier judgment bind the officer, as in Burton, absent explicit wording in the formal judgment
issues.applicant_position: Minister: Burton is distinguishable because Shore J. made no risk finding and only specified evidence to be obtained.
issues.respondent_position: Not stated in the reasons; the Federal Court relied on Burton to find the officer bound.
issues.result_quote: cannot bind the administrative decision-maker unless it is explicitly part of the formal judgment
